[Handbook home](../README.md) · [Metric definitions](02-evaluation.md) · [Paper catalog](generated/papers.md)

34 primary-source result records; 34 exact protocol groups. All values retain author/reproduction status.

Groups require equality of the full recorded protocol tuple. Unknown metadata isolates a record. A missing split identity isolates a record even when prose such as “random 80/20” matches. An identity must name a verified shared split artifact, fixed official partition, or primary experiment configuration; comparison notes remain binding. No global SOTA ranking is asserted; the highest value within a multi-row group is only the best value in this catalog under that recorded protocol, not a verified field-wide best.

## MoSu — In-domain MoSu test; full trimodal model, main Table 2. — Spearman rho (8bc35431)

| Method | Value | Runs / uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [TripleSumm](generated/papers.md#triplesumm) | 0.472 correlation coefficient | One reported train/validation/test result; independent seed count not reported.; Not reported | [Main Table 2, PDF page 7 (printed page 7); preprocessing Section 5.1 and Appendix B.4; split counts https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu .](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.01169v1) |

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** mosu
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** 42,152 training / 5,263 validation / 5,263 test videos; approximately 8:1:1 stratified by 10 thematic clusters. Dataset-card split counts; exact split-file hash not independently verified.
- **Training regime:** Replay-derived weak supervision: squared-L2 regression against MoSu Most Replayed importance targets.
- **Setting:** In-domain MoSu test; full trimodal model, main Table 2.
- **Features:** CLIP ViT-L/14 visual, RoBERTa-base transcript, AST audio; each modality 768-D before learned projections.
- **Sampling:** 1-second aligned features; visual 1 fps; timestamped transcript features broadcast over interval; audio centered 10-second windows every second.
- **Segmentation:** Not applied to this raw frame-score rank metric; Appendix A.2 separately describes KTS for keyshot rendering.
- **Shot aggregation:** Not applied to raw frame-score correlations; mean shot scores are used only for rendered summaries.
- **Budget:** Not applied to this metric; 15% keyshot budget belongs to the separate summary decoder.
- **Solver:** Not applied to raw score correlations; separate keyshot generation uses 0/1 knapsack.
- **Reference aggregation:** One normalized, bias-corrected replay-derived target sequence per video; exact across-video averaging/NaN policy not restated in main table.
- **Metric:** Spearman rho
- **Unit:** correlation coefficient
- **Runs:** One reported train/validation/test result; independent seed count not reported.
- **Variance:** Not reported
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **triplesumm-mosu-test-rho (2026-09-08):** Main Table 2 and Appendix Table XI agree on .351/.472, but Appendix D prose instead says .361/.484. Preserve the main-table values; conflict remains unresolved. No independent rerun; not temporal-overlap F1 or highlight mAP.

</details>

## SumMe — Ours (Full): trained on SumMe; TVT columns only. — Spearman rho (a16828f1)

| Method | Value | Runs / uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [TripleSumm](generated/papers.md#triplesumm) | 0.187 correlation coefficient | Five folds; independent seed repetitions not reported.; Not reported | [Main Table 3(b), PDF page 7 (printed page 7), TVT columns; evaluation setup Section 5.1 and Appendix B.5.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.01169v1) |

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** summe
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** TVT within 5-fold cross-validation: three folds training, one validation, one test (approximately 60/20/20); Appendix B.5. Split-file identities not independently verified.
- **Training regime:** Supervised squared-L2 importance regression on target-dataset training folds.
- **Setting:** Ours (Full): trained on SumMe; TVT columns only.
- **Features:** Existing GoogLeNet visual features plus RoBERTa-encoded generated captions and AST audio. Main Section 5.1 names Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct captioner; Appendix B.4 links Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct, so captioner version conflicts.
- **Sampling:** Appendix B.4 states features aligned at 1-second intervals; existing visual feature sampling/remapping details not independently verified.
- **Segmentation:** Not applied to this raw frame-score rank metric; Appendix A.2 separately describes KTS for keyshot rendering.
- **Shot aggregation:** Not applied to raw frame-score correlations; mean shot scores are used only for rendered summaries.
- **Budget:** Not applied to this metric; 15% keyshot budget belongs to the separate summary decoder.
- **Solver:** Not applied to raw score correlations; separate keyshot generation uses 0/1 knapsack.
- **Reference aggregation:** Frame-importance rank evaluation following Otani et al.; exact handling of multiple user references and undefined correlations not restated in inspected table/protocol.
- **Metric:** Spearman rho
- **Unit:** correlation coefficient
- **Runs:** Five folds; independent seed repetitions not reported.
- **Variance:** Not reported
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **triplesumm-summe-full-tvt-rho (2026-09-08):** Dedicated validation/test protocol; do not mix with the larger TV values in adjacent columns. Additional text/audio inputs differ from visual-only historical baselines. Unknown reference aggregation and feature-remapping fields prevent exact protocol-equivalence claims. No independent rerun.

</details>

## SumMe — Zhang 2016 augmented — Temporal-overlap F1 (051b481d)

| Method | Value | Runs / uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [dppLSTM](generated/papers.md#lstm-dpp) | 42.9 percent | 5 repeats per setting and testing fold (supplement Section 5.2); fold identities not reported; Standard deviation 0.5 percentage points | [Table 3, PDF page 10; protocols Table 2 and supplement Sections 1–3, 5](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ.pdf) |

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** summe
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** 80% SumMe + TVSum + OVP(50) + YouTube(39) training/validation; 20% SumMe test
- **Training regime:** Supervised: human importance/summary labels
- **Setting:** Zhang 2016 augmented
- **Features:** ImageNet GoogLeNet pool5, 1024-D
- **Sampling:** Uniform 2 fps; exact frame-index rule not reported
- **Segmentation:** KTS; about 5-second intervals; boundary artifact/hash and full settings not reported
- **Shot aggregation:** Paper: DPP-selected-keyframe density then importance-score fill; released evaluator mean-pools DPP-boosted diagonal scores
- **Budget:** 15% machine duration; rounding not fully specified in paper
- **Solver:** Approximate DPP MAP followed by shot conversion/fill; released evaluator applies final shot knapsack
- **Reference aggregation:** Maximum user F1, then mean videos (released evaluator)
- **Metric:** Temporal-overlap F1
- **Unit:** percent
- **Runs:** 5 repeats per setting and testing fold (supplement Section 5.2); fold identities not reported
- **Variance:** Standard deviation 0.5 percentage points
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **dpp-lstm-summe-augmented (2026-09-08):** No independent rerun. Paper and released dppLSTM decoder differ in description; TVSum evaluator has inherited 0.18 reference-budget discrepancy, so paper scores cannot be declared protocol-identical to later repositories. Protocol evidence: https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ-supp.pdf ; https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM/blob/master/codes/dppLSTM_eval.m

</details>

## TVSum — Ours (Full): trained on TVSum; TVT columns only. — Spearman rho (32ca4de7)

| Method | Value | Runs / uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [TripleSumm](generated/papers.md#triplesumm) | 0.259 correlation coefficient | Five folds; independent seed repetitions not reported.; Not reported | [Main Table 3(c), PDF page 7 (printed page 7), TVT columns; evaluation setup Section 5.1 and Appendix B.5.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.01169v1) |

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** tvsum
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** TVT within 5-fold cross-validation: three folds training, one validation, one test (approximately 60/20/20); Appendix B.5. Split-file identities not independently verified.
- **Training regime:** Supervised squared-L2 importance regression on target-dataset training folds.
- **Setting:** Ours (Full): trained on TVSum; TVT columns only.
- **Features:** Existing GoogLeNet visual features plus RoBERTa-encoded generated captions and AST audio. Main Section 5.1 names Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct captioner; Appendix B.4 links Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct, so captioner version conflicts.
- **Sampling:** Appendix B.4 states features aligned at 1-second intervals; existing visual feature sampling/remapping details not independently verified.
- **Segmentation:** Not applied to this raw frame-score rank metric; Appendix A.2 separately describes KTS for keyshot rendering.
- **Shot aggregation:** Not applied to raw frame-score correlations; mean shot scores are used only for rendered summaries.
- **Budget:** Not applied to this metric; 15% keyshot budget belongs to the separate summary decoder.
- **Solver:** Not applied to raw score correlations; separate keyshot generation uses 0/1 knapsack.
- **Reference aggregation:** Frame-importance rank evaluation following Otani et al.; exact handling of multiple user references and undefined correlations not restated in inspected table/protocol.
- **Metric:** Spearman rho
- **Unit:** correlation coefficient
- **Runs:** Five folds; independent seed repetitions not reported.
- **Variance:** Not reported
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **triplesumm-tvsum-full-tvt-rho (2026-09-08):** Dedicated validation/test protocol; do not mix with the larger TV values in adjacent columns. Additional text/audio inputs differ from visual-only historical baselines. Unknown reference aggregation and feature-remapping fields prevent exact protocol-equivalence claims. No independent rerun.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** tvsum
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** 80% TVSum + SumMe + OVP(50) + YouTube(39) training/validation; 20% TVSum test
- **Training regime:** Supervised: human importance/summary labels
- **Setting:** Zhang 2016 augmented
- **Features:** ImageNet GoogLeNet pool5, 1024-D
- **Sampling:** Uniform 2 fps; exact frame-index rule not reported
- **Segmentation:** KTS; about 5-second intervals; boundary artifact/hash and full settings not reported
- **Shot aggregation:** Paper: DPP-selected-keyframe density then importance-score fill; released evaluator mean-pools DPP-boosted diagonal scores
- **Budget:** 15% machine duration; rounding not fully specified in paper
- **Solver:** Approximate DPP MAP followed by shot conversion/fill; released evaluator applies final shot knapsack
- **Reference aggregation:** Mean user F1, then mean videos (released evaluator)

- **Variance:** Standard deviation 0.4 percentage points
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **dpp-lstm-tvsum-augmented (2026-09-08):** No independent rerun. Paper and released dppLSTM decoder differ in description; TVSum evaluator has inherited 0.18 reference-budget discrepancy, so paper scores cannot be declared protocol-identical to later repositories. Protocol evidence: https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ-supp.pdf ; https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM/blob/master/codes/dppLSTM_eval.m

</details>

## TripleSumm long-video test set — Zero-shot dataset transfer in Table 5; selector itself was trained. — Spearman rho (576d72c3)

| Method | Value | Runs / uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [TripleSumm](generated/papers.md#triplesumm) | 0.189 correlation coefficient | One 50-video test evaluation; independent seed count not reported.; Not reported | [Main Table 5, PDF page 10 (printed page 10); long-set description Appendix B.6, PDF page 19 (printed page iv).](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.01169v1) |

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** triplesumm-long
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** Separate 50-video long-form evaluation set; no target training/fine-tuning; primary paper Appendix B.6. Public ID/split manifest not independently verified.
- **Training regime:** Trained on MoSu replay-derived targets, then direct inference on longer unseen videos.
- **Setting:** Zero-shot dataset transfer in Table 5; selector itself was trained.
- **Features:** MoSu-trained trimodal model; exact long-set feature artifacts and caption/transcript preparation not independently verified.
- **Sampling:** MoSu model uses 1-second aligned streams; exact long-set preprocessing configuration not independently verified.
- **Segmentation:** Not applied to this raw frame-score rank metric; Appendix A.2 separately describes KTS for keyshot rendering.
- **Shot aggregation:** Not applied to raw frame-score correlations; mean shot scores are used only for rendered summaries.

- **Solver:** Not applied to raw score correlations; separate keyshot generation uses 0/1 knapsack.
- **Reference aggregation:** One Most Replayed target curve per long video, obtained using the same procedure as MoSu; exact aggregation over videos not restated.
- **Metric:** Spearman rho
- **Unit:** correlation coefficient
- **Runs:** One 50-video test evaluation; independent seed count not reported.
- **Variance:** Not reported
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **triplesumm-long-transfer-rho (2026-09-08):** Average test duration 70.4 minutes; evaluate separately from in-domain MoSu and target-finetuned SumMe/TVSum. Behavioral targets are not independent human summary choices. Public raw evaluation-set manifest not verified; no independent rerun.

</details>

## VideoXum — Text output (V2T-SUM metric) of joint VTSUM-BLIP + TT + CA. — BLEU-4 (7f73607e)

| Method | Value | Runs / uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [VTSUM-BLIP + TT + CA](generated/papers.md#videoxum) | 5.8 paper-scaled score (table labels percent) | One reported configuration; independent seed count not reported.; Not reported | [Table III, PDF page 7 (printed page 7), Cross-Modal Video Summarization block, + TT + CA row; preprocessing Section V-B and evaluation Section V-C.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2303.12060v3) |

<details>
<summary>Full protocol and comparison limits</summary>

- **Dataset id:** videoxum
- **Split identity:** Not independently verified
- **Split:** 8,000 training / 2,001 validation / 4,000 test videos; Section III-A. Split-file hash not independently verified.
- **Training regime:** Supervised joint training: frame BCE (weight 15) plus text autoregressive NLL (weight 1), frozen BLIP encoder with trainable temporal/decoder components.
- **Setting:** Text output (V2T-SUM metric) of joint VTSUM-BLIP + TT + CA.
- **Features:** BLIP ViT-B/16 image encoder (12 layers), one Temporal Transformer layer, 12-layer text decoder; CA window size 5.
- **Sampling:** Frames resized and center-cropped to 224x224; maximum video sequence length 512 with truncation (Section V-B). Original-paper sampling rate not restated in inspected passage.
- **Segmentation:** Not applied to generated-text evaluation; input frame preprocessing as described.
- **Shot aggregation:** Not applied to generated-text evaluation.
- **Budget:** Maximum text-generation length 128 (Section V-B); no extractive duration budget in this text metric.
- **Solver:** Autoregressive text decoder; exact beam/sampling settings not independently verified.
- **Reference aggregation:** Narrative paragraph references formed from ActivityNet Captions dense sentences (Section V-B); exact scorer tokenization and multi-reference pooling not independently verified.
- **Metric:** BLEU-4
- **Unit:** paper-scaled score (table labels percent)
- **Runs:** One reported configuration; independent seed count not reported.
- **Variance:** Not reported
- **Reproduction:** author-reported
- **videoxum-vtsum-blip-tt-ca-text-bleu4 (2026-09-08):** Table III scales text metrics as stated in caption; CIDEr is not a probability. Do not compare generated-text scores with frame or keyshot F1. Same joint-model row as visual result; independent task metric, not another model run. No independent rerun.

</details>

- **Dataset id:** videoxum

- **Reference aggregation:** Paper: mean F1 over ten annotations per video. Rank correlations instead use the mean of ten masks.
- **Metric:** Frame-overlap F1
- **Unit:** percent
- **Runs:** One reported configuration; independent seed count not reported.
- **Variance:** Not reported

This is the visual output of the joint model, not the VSUM-BLIP single-output row (23.1). The reported value is retained from Table III; source inspection does not establish that the inspected commit generated it. Preserve truncation, reference pairing and the inclusive-threshold budget caveat.
